The KBW Nasdaq Financial Technology Index will add Appfolio and drop Envestnet, the KBW Nasdaq Financial Sector Dividend Yield Index will drop B Riley Financial, and the KBW Nasdaq Premium Yield Equity REIT Index will drop Uniti Group.

title: AppFolio Unveils FolioSpace™ to Transform the Resident Experience and Help Customers Build Thriving Communities, Acquires LiveEasy to Accelerate its Vision
description: AppFolio unveils FolioSpace, a next-generation resident experience platform, and acquires LiveEasy, a concierge platform, to enhance its property management offerings and improve the resident experience.
